title: Per-device BasicCredential identity that still names its user
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Part (a) of the two-device fix. Each device's BasicCredential identity is distinct (e.g. the user URI plus a device part) yet names its user. Implications to settle with decision beads: participant_list keeps one entry per USER, so the hub and members must map device identity -> user URI everywhere they now compare identity to user (mimi-protocol#159 credential-to-domain rule; hub identity_domain checks; room-policy authorization by user; franking sender URI; JMAP senders); the identity syntax (a URI fragment? a /d/ path? query?) and what other implementations accept; migration of existing state.
